mainEntity.name: How do you ensure quality control through effective crew coordination on a luxury build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality control is deeply integrated with effective crew coordination on luxury builds. Our project managers conduct regular site inspections and host daily or weekly meetings with all trades to review progress, upcoming tasks, and potential interface issues. We establish clear communication channels and quality benchmarks for each phase, ensuring that every craftsman understands the high standards expected. This proactive oversight prevents mistakes, promotes accountability, and ensures every detail meets the discerning requirements of a luxury home.
